lines.text: The LORD will send sword, famine and plague on the people still in Jerusalem because they ignored His words.
The LORD will deliver Ahab and Zedekiah to the king of Egypt, who will kill them before the exiles.
The LORD says Ahab and Zedekiah committed adultery with their neighbors' wives and spoke lies in His name.
Shemaiah wrote to Zephaniah that the LORD had appointed him priest in place of Eli.
Zephaniah read the letter to Jeremiah, and the LORD said He would punish Shemaiah for preaching rebellion against Him.
